title: Checkout Service HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout Outage
description: Checkout service returning HTTP 504 gateway timeouts during peak promotion launch. Active PostgreSQL database connections reached 100/100 limit.

evidence.content: ERROR [HikariCP] Connection acquisition timeout after 30000ms. Active connections 100/100, idle 0, waiting 142 threads.
LOG: duration: 11420.50 ms statement: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 48291 ORDER BY created_at DESC. EXPLAIN ANALYZE: Seq Scan on orders (cost=0.00..84512.00 rows=2847921).
PostgreSQL Schema Audit: Foreign key orders.customer_id is missing an index, resulting in full table scans on 2.8M rows during customer order lookups.
